input.command:
S=/private/tmp/claude-502/-Users-vitaliy-Documents-GitHub-local-whisper/881e21dc-c26e-4f4f-865e-0d78e8553961/scratchpad
run() { # $1=label, shift = args
  local label="$1"; shift
  /usr/local/bin/ffmpeg -y -hide_banner "$@" > "$S/$label.log" 2>&1 &
  local p=$!; sleep 10; kill -INT $p 2>/dev/null; wait $p 2>/dev/null
}
echo "### B: single continuous file, 16k mono (no segmenter) ###"
run B -f avfoundation -i :default -ac 1 -ar 16000 "$S/B.wav"
/usr/local/bin/ffprobe -v error -show_entries format=duration -of csv=p=0 "$S/B.wav" | xargs printf "   B duration = %s s\n"
grep -o "time=[0-9:.]*" "$S/B.log" | tail -1

echo "### C: single continuous file, NO resample (native 48k f32) ###"
run C -f avfoundation -i :default "$S/C.wav"
/usr/local/bin/ffprobe -v error -show_entries format=duration -of csv=p=0 "$S/C.wav" | xargs printf "   C duration = %s s\n"
grep -o "time=[0-9:.]*" "$S/C.log" | tail -1

echo "### D: single file, 16k, with -audio_buffer_size 50 ###"
run D -f avfoundation -audio_buffer_size 50 -i :default -ac 1 -ar 16000 "$S/D.wav"
/usr/local/bin/ffprobe -v error -show_entries format=duration -of csv=p=0 "$S/D.wav" | xargs printf "   D duration = %s s\n"
grep -o "time=[0-9:.]*" "$S/D.log" | tail -1
input.description: Control tests: continuous vs segmented, resampled vs native
